compiler: GCC 15.2.0 in repository Nix shell; -O2, same explicit flags and wrapper hardening for both variants
rendererBackend: wgpu-native + Vulkan llvmpipe (LLVM21.1.8); CPU preparation/encoding benchmark only
baselineInstrumentation: Baseline source unchanged except zero-return scratch-capacity accessor added for common test linkage; counter zeros are unavailable, not zero work.
linkage: Both variants link the same freshly compiled test object and existing native dependency shared libraries. The variant MeshPath object is directly linked into the executable with --export-dynamic so it overrides the cached shared renderer definitions. No Bazel outputs changed.
preliminaryStatus: Both variants passed all 3 workloads while a separate WASM build ran. Preliminary wall times are excluded as speed evidence.
scratchHighWater: Five scratch vectors retain capacity until MeshPath teardown. The mixed fixture follows 6000-live stress, so 7548840 B is a high-water value, not a fresh mixed-frame requirement.
headerCompatibility: The baseline object uses original mesh_path.cpp against the current candidate header for the same test object/class layout. Original header is archived separately for provenance; it was not used for the A/B baseline compilation.
cleanTiming: Six alternating runs completed 2026-09-24 20:36:36–20:37:03 UTC, no overlapping known build/test/browser-probe process detected by sampler. See mesh-clean-environment.json.
